name: CD Girls -Utahime-tachi no Koi Monogatari-
source:
A mediocre hero borrowed a CD from a friend with the title "CD Girls". The moment he pushed "play" a little girl jumped out from the CD. Time stops here with only old memories and old love wounds lingering in search of cure.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
平凡的主人公向朋友借来一张名为《CD Girls》的CD。他按下播放键的瞬间，一名小女孩竟从光盘里跳了出来。时间在这里停滞，只剩古老的回忆与昔日爱情留下的伤痕，仍在寻求治愈。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
